title: Guy Daily Brief
summary: A concise editorial-style briefing focused on durable, high-signal developments across the US, world, and tech.

us.headline: Housing and lending rules remain a key pressure point
us.summary: Federal housing and lending policy continues to shape affordability, borrowing costs, and compliance pressure across the market.
us.whyItMatters: Bread-and-butter economic policy tends to matter more to daily life than the average outrage cycle.

us.headline: Regulatory and court fights still set the medium-term backdrop
us.summary: Major court and agency disputes remain among the most consequential US stories because they define what rules can actually stick.
us.whyItMatters: Power struggles between agencies, courts, and lawmakers usually outlast the daily cable-news churn.

world.headline: Diplomacy, conflict, and energy markets remain tightly linked
world.summary: Global security developments continue to spill into trade, fuel costs, and alliance politics in ways that directly affect the US.
world.whyItMatters: The world section exists for stories with real geopolitical or economic aftershocks, not abstract international trivia.

tech.headline: Security and infrastructure deserve top billing in tech coverage
tech.summary: High-impact vulnerabilities and platform-level changes should lead the tech file over gadget drops or AI hype theater.
tech.whyItMatters: If a technical story changes risk, access, cost, or developer reality, it belongs in the brief.

watchlist: New details from any major court or policy decision
Material updates on global conflict or diplomatic negotiations
Security advisories that move from disclosure to active exploitation
